title: Coleus Flamingo - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Vibrant Pink Foliage
description:
Stunning 'Flamingo' Coleus with vibrant burgundy and hot pink leaves, perfect for adding a tropical touch to your garden or home!


KEY FEATURES
• Vibrant burgundy leaves with hot pink centres
• Upright growth habit, ideal for containers and borders
• Low maintenance and easy to grow
• Can be grown as an annual outdoors or as a houseplant
• Adds a tropical and modern aesthetic


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Coleus scutellarioides 'Flamingo'
Colour: Burgundy, Pink
Season: Year-round (indoors), Summer (outdoors)
Growth Habit: Upright


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Partial Shade, Partial Sun, Full Shade
Soil: Well-drained, rich in organic matter
Watering: Moderate, keep evenly moist but avoid soggy soil
Spacing: 12 inches apart
Height: 16-24 inches
Spread: 12-15 inches
Hardiness: USDA Zone 10-11


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in well-drained soil, burying the plug completely.
• Water regularly, ensuring the soil does not completely dry out.
• Pinch off any flower spikes to encourage bushier growth and direct energy to the foliage.
• For best foliage colour, maintain light intensity at 1,500-3,000 fc.
• Overwinter indoors in zones below 10 or grow as a permanent houseplant.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
